meta.game: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time (N64 100% definition)
meta.subtitle: Switch 2 remake — midnight-launch one-sitting 100% binge route
meta.scope: Single-playthrough, glitchless, missable-safe linear route to community 100%: 36 Heart Pieces, 100 Gold Skulltulas, 12 songs, all equipment / items / capacity upgrades, 4 bottles, both trade sequences (Biggoron's Sword + Happy Mask), all 6 Great Fairy upgrades, 3 Spiritual Stones, 6 Medallions, and every dungeon.
meta.confidencePolicy: Fully hardened: all 36 Heart Pieces AND all 100 Gold Skulltulas are now individually itemized with exact locations/methods and the canonical #1–#100 numbering. Each token is its own checkbox. Still trust the in-game Gold Skulltula count as the ultimate source of truth. Re-check on launch night whether the remake adds/moves anything (this baseline is original N64).
meta.remakeNote: Built pre-release on the original N64 100% baseline. Patch in remake-specific changes on launch night.
meta.sources: Heart Pieces: thonky.com/ocarina-of-time/pieces-of-heart (36 total). Gold Skulltulas: jegged.com Gold-Skulltulas (canonical #1–100), cross-checked vs thonky.com (100 total).

confidenceLegend.high: Cross-confirmed, fixed in the original game (all Heart Pieces + all 100 numbered Gold Skulltulas).

phases.blurb: The timed Biggoron trade, the Big Poe and Lon Lon bottles, and the remaining spells/arrows.

steps.title: Biggoron's Sword trade chain (TIMED)
steps.loc: Kakariko → Lost Woods → DM → Lake → Zora → back
steps.do: Pocket Egg → Cojiro → Odd Mushroom → Odd Potion → Poacher's Saw → Broken Goron's Sword → Prescription → Eyeball Frog → Eyedrops → Claim Check. Several legs are on a clock.
steps.missableNote: Odd Mushroom and Eyeball Frog → Eyedrops → World's Finest are timed; deliver fast or redo that leg.

items.label: Biggoron's Sword
Biggoron trade chain complete

steps.title: Bottle #3 — Big Poe
steps.loc: Hyrule Field (on Epona, night) → Ghost Shop (Market)
steps.do: Catch a Big Poe and sell it at the Ghost Shop → empty Bottle.

items.label: Bottle (Big Poe)

steps.title: Bottle #4 — Lon Lon Super Cucco game
steps.loc: Lon Lon Ranch (wake Talon, play the cucco game)
steps.do: Find the 3 special cuccos in time → Bottle (with Lon Lon Milk).

items.label: Bottle (Lon Lon cucco game)

steps.title: Remaining spells & arrows
steps.do: Confirm Din's Fire / Farore's Wind / Nayru's Love, plus Fire Arrows (Lake Hylia — shoot the rising sun from the island) and Ice Arrows (Training Ground). Light Arrows come from Zelda before Ganon's Castle.

items.label: Fire Arrows (Lake Hylia)

steps.title: Capacity upgrades (Bullet Bag & Bomb Bag)
steps.loc: Market shooting gallery / Lost Woods scrub / Bombchu Bowling
steps.do: Bullet Bag upgrades (40 → 50 seeds) from the shooting galleries; Bomb Bag capacity upgrades (20 → 30 → 40) from the Goron and Bombchu Bowling prizes.

items.label: Bullet Bag upgrades
Bomb Bag capacity upgrades

phases.title: Final audit, Ganon's Castle & the end
phases.blurb: Golden Gauntlets, Double Defense, Light Arrows, the 100-Skulltula reward, then finish.

steps.title: FINAL 100% audit before the point of no return
steps.do: Every meter should read full: Heart Pieces 36 (÷4 = 9 containers), Gold Skulltulas 100, all 12 songs, both swords + Biggoron, all 3 tunics / boots / shields, 4 bottles, both trade chains, 6 Great Fairies, 3 stones + 6 medallions, every dungeon.
steps.missableNote: Treat this as the wall — finish all collectibles before entering Ganon's Castle's final stretch.

steps.title: 100-Skulltula reward
steps.do: The cursed family is fully restored at 100 tokens (Huge Rupee). HP #23 at 50 was grabbed earlier.

items.label: 100 GS reward (family restored / Huge Rupee)

steps.title: Ganon's Castle — Golden Gauntlets, Double Defense & Light Arrows
steps.do: Light Arrows from Zelda; the Spirit trial grants the Golden Gauntlets; the moat Great Fairy gives Double Defense.

items.label: Light Arrows
Golden Gauntlets
Great Fairy — Double Defense

steps.title: Gold Skulltula — Ganon's Castle (1)
steps.do: The very last overworld token.

items.label: #47 — Ganon's Castle: where Hyrule Castle used to be — on the back of the archway (adult)

steps.title: Defeat Ganondorf / Ganon — finish the game
steps.do: 100% in one sitting. GG.

items.label: Ganon's Castle (cleared)
